remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash from allowed-tools unless the skill adds specific, reviewed shell operations that are required for plan creation.

content.value_statement: Complex projects can lose context when plans live in loose notes. This skill creates a PLAN.md index and numbered task files with checklists.
actual_capabilities: Creates a PLAN.md master index for a project or feature plan.
Creates numbered task files using three digit prefixes and slug names.
Adds required sections for goals, dependencies, scope, checklist, tests, and completion criteria.
Updates existing plans while preserving assigned task numbers.
Tracks completed work through Markdown checkboxes in task files and the index.
Documents blockers, dependencies, parallel work, and optional retrospectives.
limitations: It writes planning documents, not application code or implementation changes.
It needs a title, slug, and task list to produce a useful plan.
It does not prove that generated test commands pass.
It can edit files in the selected plan location, so paths should be reviewed.

use_cases.title: Plan a Feature Build
use_cases.description: Break a feature into numbered tasks with dependencies, tests, and completion criteria.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Migration
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable migration plan with locked decisions, blockers, and staged verification steps.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project Progress
use_cases.description: Update an existing plan as tasks finish, change, split, or become blocked.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new project plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a plan directory for my feature. Title: User Authentication. Slug: user-auth. Tasks: user model, login, password reset, tests.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Specific Location
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt with a target folder and constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a plan in docs/plans/billing-redesign. Use the slug billing-redesign. Include tasks for data model, UI, API, migration, and QA. Keep Stripe as the payment provider.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the existing user-auth plan. Add a new task for Google OAuth, preserve all current task numbers, and mark it dependent on JWT setup.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Complex Execution Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt with dependencies, parallel work, and verification.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration plan for moving from REST to GraphQL. Include backend schema work, client migration, compatibility testing, rollout gates, rollback criteria, and parallel tasks where safe.

output_examples.input: Create a plan for adding user authentication with JWT and password reset.
output: A PLAN.md index with purpose, locked decisions, task links, and completion checks.
Task files for user model, JWT setup, login endpoints, password reset, and integration tests.
Each task includes dependencies, scope, checklist items, tests, and measurable completion criteria.

output_examples.input: Add OAuth support to the existing authentication plan.
output: The existing PLAN.md is read before changes are made.
A new numbered OAuth task is appended without renumbering earlier tasks.
The task index is updated to link the new task and show its pending status.

output_examples.input: Mark the JWT setup task as complete.
output: Checklist and completion items are checked in the matching task file.
The corresponding PLAN.md task index entry is checked when all task items are complete.
The response confirms which plan files were updated.

best_practices: Provide a clear title, slug, task list, and target location before generating files.
Keep PLAN.md as an index and put detailed work inside numbered task files.
Review generated dependencies and test steps before using the plan for execution.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for a single informal todo list.
Do not renumber existing tasks after work has started.
Do not ask it to run implementation tests unless you also authorize that work separately.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a Markdown plan directory with a PLAN.md index and numbered task files.

faq.question: Can it update an existing plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads the current PLAN.md and updates task files, checkboxes, and task indexes.

faq.question: Does it execute the plan tasks?
faq.answer: No. It structures the plan and progress records. Execution remains a separate user decision.

faq.question: Why are task files numbered?
faq.answer: Stable numbering keeps references, dependencies, and history clear as the plan changes.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The format is plain Markdown and the skill states support for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a plan title, slug, task list, target folder, constraints, and testing expectations.
